sentences.text:
Author: Joymalya Bagchi
Bench: Joymalya Bagchi
 In The High Court At Calcutta
 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
01.10.2024
 28
 sdas
 C.R.R. No. 3488 of 2024
 In Re : Sri Manash Kumar Paul & Ors. .....petitioners
 Mr. Ivan Roy
 Mr. Debangshu Bandhu
 ....... for the petitioners
 1.
Learned Counsel for the petitioners submits opposite party no. 2 is residing separately since 2019.
Proceeding under Protection of Women for Domestic Violence Act was instituted in 2021.

entities.text: Protection of Women for Domestic Violence Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Belatedly impugned criminal proceeding has been maliciously initiated.
They pray for quashing of the proceeding.
2. I have considered the materials on record.
After a lapse of four years impugned criminal proceeding has been instituted.
There is considerable delay in lodging criminal proceeding.
Possibility of malicious institution of the proceeding cannot be ruled out.
Petitioner has made out a prima facie case.

3. Copy of the petition be served upon opposite party 1/State through learned Public Prosecutor,
High Court, Calcutta and opposite party no. 2 through registered speed post with acknowledgement due and affidavit-of-service be filed on the next date of hearing.

4. Let this matter appear under the heading "Contested Application" four weeks after Puja Vacation.
5.

There shall be stay of operation of the proceedings in connection with A.C.G.R. No. 4973 of 2023 arising out of Parnasree Police Station Case No. 403 of 2023 dated 24.09.2023 under Sections 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code pending before the court of the learned Additional Chief Judicial CRR/3488/2024 on 1 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196159752/
1 Magistrate, Alipore, South 24 Parganas, for a period of six weeks after Puja Vacation or until further orders whichever is earlier.
6. Liberty is given to the parties to pray for extension and/or vacation and/or modification of this order upon notice to the other side.
7. Urgent photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, shall be given to the parties as expeditiously as possible on compliance of all necessary formalities.
(Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
CRR/3488/2024 on 1 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196159752/
2
